02 / THE OPPORTUNITY

AN OVERLOOKED LOCAL RESOURCE

Conch is iconic.
The shell has more to give.

Across The Bahamas, conch shell remains after the meat is removed. Much of it has limited commercial use and can accumulate around docks, coastlines and disposal areas.

We are building the equipment, products and supply relationships to turn that familiar material into considered inputs for agriculture and other markets.
